stem.archstudio.sections_overview_help: Choose a depth to inspect a section through the build.
stem.archstudio.sections_empty: No blocks at this depth in the current frame. Choose another depth or show all depths.
stem.archstudio.sections_empty_build: This frame has no blocks. Add blocks or choose another replay step.
stem.archstudio.sections_scope: The drawing includes blocks hidden by floor, material, and shape filters in the 3D view.
stem.archstudio.sections_grid: Sections affect the 3D view. The floor grid continues to show the full editing floor.
stem.archstudio.sections_cells: The drawing shows occupied cells, including curved and sloped shapes.
stem.archstudio.sections_close_help: Closing shows all depths. Reopening resumes this section.
